name: Melanocyte
failures: Autoimmune loss in vitiligo, malignant transformation to melanoma.

see.note: Directly visible; dermoscopy and biopsy are routine.

reach.note: Topical and intralesional access is straightforward.

edit.note: JAK inhibitors modulate the autoimmune driver; melanocytes are not repaired or replaced.

anchors: Ruxolitinib cream for vitiligo, FDA 2022 — treats the driver, not the cell
